text:
# Question 1

#Creating vector
ndims <- sample(3:10, 1)
print(ndims)

[1] 4

#Reshuffling values
newdims <- sample(1:(ndims^2))
#Creating matrix
mat1 <- matrix(data = newdims, nrow = sqrt(length(newdims)))
print(mat1)

     [,1] [,2] [,3] [,4]
[1,]    2    3   15   14
[2,]    8   11    9    6
[3,]   12    1    5   13
[4,]    7    4   10   16

#Transposing matrix
mat1 <- t(mat1)
print(mat1)

     [,1] [,2] [,3] [,4]
[1,]    2    8   12    7
[2,]    3   11    1    4
[3,]   15    9    5   10
[4,]   14    6   13   16

sum(mat1[1,])

[1] 29

mean(mat1[1,])

[1] 7.25

sum(mat1[sqrt(length(newdims)),])

[1] 49

mean(mat1[sqrt(length(newdims)),])

[1] 12.25

eigenmat <- eigen(mat1) 
typeof(eigenmat$values)

[1] "double"

typeof(eigenmat$vectors) #They are all complex

[1] "double"

# Question 2

#Creating list
my_matrix <- matrix(runif(16), nrow = 4)
veclog <- runif(100)
my_logical <- veclog>.5
my_letters <- sample(letters)

new_list <- list(my_matrix = my_matrix[2,2], my_logical = my_logical[2], my_letters = my_letters[2])
typeof(new_list$my_matrix) #checking types of data

[1] "double"

typeof(new_list$my_logical)

[1] "logical"

typeof(new_list$my_letters)

[1] "character"

new_vec <- c(new_list$my_matrix, new_list$my_logical, new_list$my_letters)
typeof(new_vec) #Checking data type of new vector, they are all characters

[1] "character"

print(z)

#3
set.seed(123)
nums <- runif(2)
r <- sqrt((nums[1]^2+nums[2]^2))
#Used formula for converting x to r by using the positions of the random numbers in the random uniform distribution
theta <- atan(nums[2]/nums[1])
#Used formula for converting y to theta by using the positions of the random numbers in the random uniform distribution

#4
queue <- c("sheep", "fox", "owl", "ant")
queue <- c(queue, "serpent")
queue <- queue[-1]
queue <- c("donkey", queue)
queue <- queue[-5]
queue <- queue[-3]
queue <- c(queue[1:2], "aphid", queue[3])
which(queue == "aphid")

[1] 3
